_comment: Mood anchors (PROCMUSIC.md §5) — each anchor is a complete aesthetic
snapshot: a position on the mood plane, a full genome, and FX params by
dsp Param name. The plane has no fixed semantics; distance is the only
meaning. Expansion = inverse-distance² blend over all anchors, done by
the mood_expander plugin (Pi) and the host's --mood audition rig (Mac),
both reading THIS file. Values are first drafts — tune by ear and add
anchors freely; new genes default in old anchors (serde default).
FX values apply in host audition now; they reach the Daisy with the P2
CC transport. fx.tape.failure stays the door graph's — TapeFailure here
is audition-only until that arbitration is designed.
